name: 張烔堡
objective:
最小迴轉半徑測試，轉向力測試，運轉測試，燃料消耗測試，煞車測試，加速測試，滑行測試，最高速率測試，爬坡測試，牽引測試，行駛測試，排氣污染量測試，水箱散熱測試，冷卻劑沸點測試，小客車及貨車規範。
Minimum Turning Radius Test, Steering Effort Test, Running Test, Fuel Consumption Test, Brake Test, Acceleration Test, Coasting Test, Maximum Speed Test, Steep Hill Climbing Test, Traction Test, Driving Test, Exhaust Pollution Test, Heat Dissipation Test of Radiators, Test for Boiling Point of Coolants, Standard Form of Specification for Passenger Cars and Motor Trucks.

第 03 週 Principle of Minimum Turning Radius Test

第 05 週 Principle of Brake Test

第 08 週 Principle of Acceleration Test
第 09 週 Midterm Exam

第 11 週 Principle of Coasting Test

第 13 週 Principle of Heat Dissipation Test of Radiators

第 17 週 HVAC performance test for Electric Vehicles
第 18 週 Final Report

Homework, quiz and Attendance 30%
Midterm Exam 35%
Final Report 35%
consultation: Tuesday and Wednesday, 9 AM to 12 AM @ Integrated Technology Complex Building, Room 113. Available after class or by appointment at other times. No homework assistance by e-mail.
